newsitem.title: USA: Fleming to pay $19.9 mln to settle lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Fleming to pay $19.9 mln to settle lawsuit.

text.p: Fleming Cos Inc said Tuesday it had agreed to settle litigation with David's Supermarkets Inc by paying $19.9 million in exchange for mutual releases between the parties.
The settlement is subject to funding of the settlement amount, which should occur within a month, Fleming said.
Other parties to the case separately reached agreement to resolve all remaining issues, clearing the way for entry of a final order dismissing the entire case, it said.
Fleming said its claims against David's Supermarkets and its founder are covered by the mutual release, but Fleming is not dismissing its claims against David's Supermarkets counsel Bill Sims.
Fleming Chairman and Chief Executive Robert Stauth said, "This settlement is not an admission of liability by anyone, but a pragmatic business decision to avoid a protracted and costly legal battle.

An earlier judgment of $207.5 million plus interest against Fleming was set aside. A new trial was to begin in May. David's originally sued Fleming alleging fraud, breach of contract and other wrongdoing.
Fleming is a food marketing and distribution company.
